candidate.blueprint_locator: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies, printed p.12/PDF p.16
candidate.educational_objective: Define elimination half-life in clinically relevant pharmacokinetic terms.

options.A: The approximate time required for the amount or concentration of drug in the body to decrease by 50%
options.B: The time required for every molecule of drug to leave the body completely
options.C: The time until a medication reaches its expiration date
options.D: The interval between manufacturing and dispensing

candidate.rationale: Elimination half-life is the time required for the amount or concentration of a drug in the body to decline by approximately one-half during elimination.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Drug half-life is the time required for the amount/concentration to fall by approximately 50%.
candidate.source_locator: Elimination half-life definition: time required for plasma concentration/amount to decrease by 50%
candidate.source_organization: National Library of Medicine / NCBI Bookshelf (StatPearls)
candidate.stem: What does a drug's elimination half-life describe?
